iṣṭaṃ rāgaviṣayaṃ bāhyaviṣayaṃ tyaktvā saṃvedanaṃ
svātmamātrākāravṛttidhārā tadrūpiṇā pauruṣeṇa yatnena jīyate

svātmasaṃvidā svātmatattvasākṣātkāreṇa niḥsapatnaṃ
svasāmrājyasukhavirodhimohādiśatrurahitamata evāniṅganamacalamanādyantaṃ
svārājyasukhamihāsminneva jīvanmuktadehe ucyatām

saṃkalparūpasya anarthasya śāsane nigrahe śāntāyāṃ
śāntyādisādhanasaṃpannāyāṃ jīvanmuktau

cittaṃ ciraṃ tāṃ mahāpadavīṃ
brahmarūpatāmadhigataṃ prāptaṃ kṛtvānte sākṣātkāravṛttyāvirbhūtacittā
samanaskāvidyābādhāccidbhakṣitaṃ kṛtvā cittādapi paraḥ pūrṇacinmātrarūpo
bhavetyarthaḥ

tatra prathamaṃ cinmātrabhāvanayā yukto bhava tatsthairyārthaṃ paramayā
atisāvadhānayā dhiyā buddhyā yukto bhava

tato grastacittaṃ tataścittātparaṃ
ātmānaṃ dhāraya sthāpaya nānyadityarthaḥ

yathā diṅmohe acalā sthirāpi pratīcyāṃ prācīti
saṃvedanaviparyāsadhīrvivekasthairyalakṣaṇena puruṣaprayatnena jetuṃ śakyate
tadvanmano'pītyarthaḥ

ciraṃ manonigrahe pravṛttasyodvegāttatparityāgo mā bhūditi tadutsāhaṃ
vardhayannāha - anudvega iti

śrīsukhe yuddha śastradalanakadarthanā svargasukhe utpāto mṛtvā
ūrdhvagamanaṃ tataḥ pāta iti kadarthanā manojayasukhe tu na kāpītyāha - na
śastreti

samādhisuptyādau janmamaraṇādiduḥkhānāmananubhavādvyavahārakāle
manovṛttipūrvakameva tadanubhavācca manovṛttimātratvaṃ saṃsārasyeti
darśayati - pumānityādinā

ihaloke ihalokena ihalokātmanā vicaratu bhrāmyatu paratra paraloke ca
paralokabhāveneti śeṣaḥ

asya saṃsārasya
cittādanyadrūpaṃ na vidyata ityarthaḥ

ataḥ paramātmani samūlacittanāśa eva muktyupāyo nānya iti
pariśeṣayannupasaṃharati - satītyādinā

ṛte pramāṇamūrdhanyaśrutibodhite
paramātmani cito bhāvaścittā tayā
upaśamanāttadbhāvamātrapariśeṣalakṣaṇāccittasyopaśamanāt ṛte vinā
mukterupāyo'nyo nāsti

etadūrdhvamūrdhvalokeṣu adhastāt pātālādilokeṣu tiryak parito dvīpāntareṣu ca
tattvadarśibhirvicārya nirdhāritamityuttareṇa sahānvayaḥ

manovilaye ca samādhiparipākapariṣkṛte manasyaparokṣatayā
āvirbhūtabrahmātmakabodha evopāya ityāśayenāha - ṛte tathye iti

vyāyate atyantavistīrṇe hṛdayākāśe daharākāśarūpe brahmaciti
caramavṛttiddhacillakṣaṇayā cakradhārayā mano mārayeti pareṇānvayaḥ
ādhayo mānasaduḥkhāni tvāṃ na prabadhnanti na bandhayiṣyanti

āpātaramyeṣu
viṣayeṣu doṣānusaṃdhānenāramyatādarśanaṃ prathamaṃ
saṃpādyamityāśayenāha - yadīti

ayaṃ
dṛśyamānaḥ sa pitrā utpādito dehaḥ ahaṃ idaṃ dehasaṃbandhi gṛhakṣetrādi
tatprāk pitrādyarjitaṃ me madīyaṃ iti yo bhrama etāvanmātrakaṃ
etāvaccharīrakaṃ mana ityarthaḥ

vātena yathā chinnābhramaṇḍalaṃ dhūyate nirasyate tathā evaṃ
prāguktenāhaṃmetyakalpanena mano dhūyata ityarthaḥ
cetolakṣaṇaṃ siṃhaṃ ye ghnanti te jayanti sarvotkarṣeṇa vartante

mana eva mahābhayaṃ manojaya evābhayapratiṣṭhetyāha - bhīmā iti
dvābhyām

avaṣṭabdhamavalambitaṃ tatparamātmapadasiṃhāsanaṃ yena tathāvidhaḥ san
asaṃkalpanasāmrājye tiṣṭha

yathā aṅgārakṣayārthino jvaladaṅgāranāśena
tāpopaśamasukhārthinaḥ puruṣasya kāṣṭhāpasaraṇenakṣīṇāṅgakaḥ
kramādbhasmībhāvāpannāvayavaḥ soṅgārastāpopaśamanānandaṃ prayacchati
tadvadityarthaḥ

saṃkalpavṛddhau brahmāṇḍalakṣāṇāmapi cidaṇūdare kalpanā saṃpadyata
ityāha - apīti

saṃkalpamātralakṣaṇena svavibhavena susādhitā brahmāṇḍakoṭyādipadārthā
yena ata eva saṃkalpamātravibhavenaiva kṛtā atyanarthā janmamaraṇanirayādayo
yena tattathāvidhaṃ mano nityoditena nirantarabhāvitena nirīhitena niḥsaṃkalpena
saṃtoṣamātravibhavena vijitya vijayaṃ sarvotkarṣaṃ ehi prāpnuhi

ātmavidāṃ matayā saṃmatayā avaiṣamyavṛttyā śamitayā nirastayā amitayā
vahnyā ahaṃtayāpi antaḥ yat ajaṃ janmādivikāraśūnyaṃ padamavaśiṣṭaṃ
tadeva tavāstu prāpyamiti āśiṣi loṭ
